top5.title: Jensen Huang steps down as NVIDIA CEO after 33 years
top5.description: Jensen Huang has stepped down as NVIDIA’s CEO after 33 years. The planned succession and its implications for the company are at the center of questions.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s departure after 33 years would create major uncertainty for Nvidia’s strategy, valuation, leadership succession, and the broader AI-chip market.

top5.title: Anthropic’s IPO becomes a test for the entire AI sector
top5.description: The creator of Claude is set to list on the Nasdaq at between 70 and 78 dollars per share, amid a difficult environment for AI and Nvidia. Anthropic plans to spend more than 900 billion dollars with suppliers despite a 104-billion-dollar loss over nine months.
top5.why: Anthropic’s planned IPO and enormous supplier commitments will be a crucial test of investor confidence in the economics and capital intensity of the AI industry.

top5.title: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT Wallet to let agents make payments
top5.description: ChatGPT Wallet, developed with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, lets agents make payments by replacing card details with a token. The rollout begins on Dots for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the United States.
top5.why: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Wallet moves AI agents toward real-world commerce and could establish new payment, tokenization, and platform relationships.

top5.title: A compromised MCP server can hijack an AI agent’s other tools
top5.description: A test cited by VentureBeat found that a compromised MCP server could prompt an agent connected to five servers to misuse the other tools in 78.3% of cases. The article recommends limiting credentials, adding human approvals, and logging the entire call chain.
top5.why: The finding that a compromised MCP server can hijack an agent’s other tools exposes a serious security risk as enterprises connect autonomous agents to multiple systems.

top5.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship in midair in Texas
top5.description: SpaceX successfully caught Starship with the mechanical arms of its launch tower after its spaceflight. The catch is important proof of feasibility, although an attempt to catch Super Heavy was aborted during the previous flight.
top5.why: SpaceX’s successful midair Starship catch is a major milestone toward a rapidly reusable heavy-lift launch system with potentially transformative effects on space access.
